title: Knowledge Base: Don't Let Your Team's Knowledge Get “Lost”
description: Have you ever wondered what would happen if one day your Senior Engineer quit?
flags: Title: “Thất Lạc” rendered as “Lost” (kept the author's scare quotes) — it means knowledge going astray/being mislaid, not merely being deleted.
§4: “available” kept as the technical loanword; “Cái này hỏi anh A nhé” rendered as “Ask A about this one.”
Headings kept as literal section markers (# 1. … # 36.) matching the source numbering.
